title: Pivot Table Builder
description: Twenty raw sign-in rows, two dropdowns, and a grand total that never changes.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Analyzing Club Data and Choosing the Right Tools

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a small raw attendance dataset, the learner constructs a pivot table summarizing session counts by the row and column fields they select.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Pick which field becomes rows and which becomes columns; the grid rebuilds live
pedagogical.assessment: Predict a cell's count from the raw rows before reading it off the grid.
